# Enovation Controls, a Helios Technologies Operating Company, Earns Three Additional 2026 UK Best Workplaces™ Recognitions


October 01, 2026 9:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_bd4c8ce9f379c8bdc9c8fea52800bf21/heliostechnologies/news/2026-10-01_Enovation_Controls_a_Helios_Technologies_373.pdf)


SARASOTA, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Helios Technologies, Inc.](https://www.heliostechnologies.com/) (NYSE: HLIO) (“Helios” or the “Company”), a global leader in highly engineered motion control and electronic controls technology, today announced that its operating company[Enovation Controls](https://www.enovationcontrols.com/) has earned recognition across three of[Great Place To Work® UK](https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1559221) ’s 2026 Best Workplaces™ lists, reflecting the strength and consistency of the employee experience across its United Kingdom operations. These honors are in addition to the[recognition Enovation Controls received earlier this year](https://www.heliostechnologies.com/news/press-releases/detail/368/enovation-controls-a-helios-technologies-operating) when it was named to the UK’s Best Workplaces for Women™ list for the fifth consecutive year.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261001550150/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261001550150/en/)


Together, the three honors recognize distinct aspects of the workplace Enovation Controls’ UK team has built, from trust and employee wellbeing to a strong culture within the manufacturing sector.


Enovation Controls’ new 2026 recognitions include:


- [UK’s Best Workplaces™ 2026](https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/best-workplaces/2026?keyword=enovation&size=small) (Small)
- [UK’s Best Workplaces for Wellbeing™ 2026](https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/best-workplaces/wellbeing/2026?keyword=enovation&size=small) (Small)
- [UK’s Best Workplaces in Manufacturing, Production & Transportation™ 2026](https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/best-workplaces/manufacturing/2026?size=small_medium&keyword=enovation) (Small & Medium)


“Earning recognition across three additional Best Workplaces lists is especially meaningful because it comes directly from the experiences and feedback of our employees,” said Billy Aldridge, President, Electronics for Helios. “Our UK team has built a culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to one another. We are proud to see that reflected across these areas of the employee experience, and we remain committed to listening, learning, and continuing to build a workplace where people can grow, contribute, and thrive.”


Great Place To Work® UK’s Best Workplaces™ recognition is based on employee feedback and an assessment of workplace culture. For example, for the Manufacturing, Production & Transportation™ list, Great Place To Work® analyzes anonymous feedback from UK-based employees about areas including work-life balance, fulfillment, job satisfaction, psychological safety, and financial security, as well as the consistency of the employee experience across departments and seniority levels.


“The UK’s Best Workplaces excel in creating consistently great experiences for all employees through fostering high levels of trust, pride, and camaraderie to fuel increased organisational performance. These crucial elements collectively contribute to creating cultures where employees feel they can truly be themselves and thrive in a supportive and caring environment. Congratulations to Enovation Controls for achieving a place on our 2026 UK’s Best Workplaces List,” said Benedict Gautrey, Managing Director of Great Place To Work® UK.


These 2026 recognitions continue Enovation Controls’ multi-year track record on Great Place To Work® UK’s Best Workplaces lists, underscoring an ongoing focus on employee feedback, development, wellbeing, and an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute.


**About Great Place To Work®**


Great Place To Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, on a mission to make every company a great workplace for all. Every year, they receive direct feedback from over 10 million workers around the world telling them how they really feel about their employer. Their survey is completely confidential and anonymous, so people can feel comfortable to be honest about their workplace, and companies can gain detailed insights into how they can better serve their people. Only those employers who have the highest levels of trust, job satisfaction, and who empower all their employees to thrive both in and outside of work are awarded official Best Workplaces™ recognition.


**About Enovation Controls**


Enovation Controls is a fast-growing and innovative manufacturer of electronic controls and displays for diverse markets. As an international leader in fully tailored solutions, Enovation Controls offers a broad range of displays, controls, and instrumentation products for various applications. With an internationally diverse team, we serve customers around the world through our global sales, manufacturing, and engineering operations. Enovation Controls partners directly with OEMs and supports a worldwide network of authorized distributors and system integrators. Visit us at[www.enovationcontrols.com](http://www.enovationcontrols.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/enovationcontrols) .


**About Helios Technologies**


Helios Technologies is a global leader in highly engineered motion control and electronic controls technology, providing premium products that ensure safety, reliability, and seamless connectivity to diverse end markets including agriculture, construction, data centers, energy, health and wellness, industrial, marine, material handling, and recreational vehicles. Helios sells its products to customers in over 80 countries around the world. Its strategy is to be a diversified, customer-centric global enterprise distinguished by innovation, operational speed, and a high-performance culture. The Company has paid a cash dividend to its shareholders every quarter since becoming a public company in 1997. For more information please visit:[www.heliostechnologies.com](http://www.heliostechnologies.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/helios-technologies-inc/) .
